title: The universality problem for C-free graphs
exact_target: Which finite lists of forbidden finite subgraphs permit a countable graph containing every countable graph avoiding that list as an induced subgraph?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 7600011 (AMR-075-0011). CC BY 4.0.

Gregory Cherlin, Saharon Shelah and Niandong Shi, Universal Graphs with Forbidden Subgraphs and Algebraic Closure, arXiv:math/9809202v1 (15 September 1998), General Theory and Section 1, Definition 1, p. 3; Introduction, pp. 1--2.
